correctness.rationale: For \(q>0\) the angular diffusion with Poisson orientation resetting is ergodic with compact generator and a simple, isolated stationary eigenvalue. Feynman–Kac identifies the cumulant growth rate with the sixth derivative of the analytic tilted eigenvalue. The exact left-eigenmeasure Fourier recursion depends only on modes with \(n+j\le6\) at sixth order; symbolic rational reconstruction yields the stated numerator and denominator without an uncontrolled cutoff. The descending coefficient signs have exactly two changes. Exact rational polynomial signs at 1/4, 13/50, 29/20, 3/2 give two disjoint roots; Descartes forces precisely two simple roots. Brownian translation only contributes a quadratic cumulant. The packaged script reproduces the algebra, brackets, \(q\to0\) normalization and five independent spectral approximation diagnostics; the analytic proof, not finite numerics, proves the infinite claim.

value.rationale: Higher-order cumulants measure non-Gaussian long-time longitudinal fluctuations of experimentally relevant direction-reset swimmers. A complete positive–negative–positive phase diagram in the natural parameter r/d is not implied by the literature’s second/fourth moments, and proves two exact qualitative transitions even when ordinary diffusivity remains nonnegative. The exact scale-free thresholds and invariance under independent translational noise give a natural protocol-diagnostic target, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a numerical root guess.
